component.name: BentoPDF Native
component.summary: Offline PDF tools in a locked-down desktop shell (unofficial)

description.p: BentoPDF Native runs the BentoPDF toolset (merge, split, compress, OCR, convert and more) entirely offline in a sandboxed Electron window. Documents never leave your computer; the application makes no network requests and has no network permission in this package.
This is an unofficial, community-built packaging of BentoPDF. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the BentoPDF project. The application never updates itself.
